title: The version checks record nothing of the image members boot
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)

evidence.verified: TestUpstreamRecordsTheImageMembersBoot, TestUpstreamRecordsTheImageCSSandboxImageNames and TestUpstreamNamesTheBinaryCSSandboxBinPicks pass under `go test ./internal/cli/ -count=1`. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 8fd7503, once a macOS smoke job was run again: podman there had refused to start a container.

resolution: `UpstreamCheck` and upstream-fingerprint.json record the image members boot, as the host holds it: its reference, podman's ID for it, and the revision its label names. A deviation names the binary it asked, which `CS_SANDBOX_BIN` may pick.
details: `UpstreamCheck` and `upstream-fingerprint.json` record the cs-sandbox version, and nothing of the image its members boot. Once a local build of a version can be tagged under a localhost/ name, the version alone no longer says which bytes a campaign ran on. The doctor also says `cs-sandbox on PATH` when `CS_SANDBOX_BIN` names another binary.
